fields.Habitat: The drowned quarter, Gulf of Maro

blocks.text: Pale, eyeless serpents the length of a longboat that nest in the sunken streets of old Maro. They surface on moonless nights and follow lantern light. Fishermen in [[Port Vellen]] paint eyes on their hulls to confuse them — nobody can say whether it works, only that the painted boats come back.
They aren't animals. They're the drowned kingdom's grave-wards, grown strange — they answer to whoever wears [[The Hollow Crown]].
